newsitem.title: UK: T&N to fund new provisions from cash-flow.
newsitem.headline: T&N to fund new provisions from cash-flow.

text.p: T&N Plc, which on Wednesday announced a huge insurance package to cap its liability for future health claims arising from its asbestos manufacturing past, said it intended to fund the provisions over two to three years with cash from free cash flow, the sale of non-core activities and external sources.
"The directors will seek to reduce any recourse to shareholders and, in any event, do not intend to raise equity funds for this purpose in the near term," the company said in a statement.
The key provision is the creation of a 323 million stg fund in respect of future potential claims which it calls IBNR claims.

In addition, the company intends to take an extra contingency provision of 50 million for possible past claims that may rebound if the disputed Georgine settlement system in the U.S. collapses after its ongoing legal review.
